items.title: ON Semiconductor Stock Is Already Half Off Its High, So How Low Could A Market Shock Take It?
items.summary: ON Semiconductor (ON) stock trades near $67, about 50% below its 52-week high. It lost 43.7% over the trailing three months, ending with a 9.0% fall on September 16. Yet it is still up 38.4% over the trailing twelve months, against 15.5% for the S&P 500. The company's latest results show a business still shrinking but recovering, not one in trouble.

items.title: Onsemi Stock Sinks as New Power Platform Fails to Impress
items.summary: Shares of  On Semiconductor  which makes power management technology used in cars and artificial intelligence data centers, fell 9% Wednesday as its Investor Day disappointed investors, despite a big announcement.  The Scottsdale, Ariz.-based company said its new Embedded Power Platform, which is designed for use in AI data centers and electric cars for power switching, driving, and controlling, delivers three to five times more power density than current solutions.  Auto maker Subaru is one of  Onsemi’s  first partners testing the new technology, which “is expected to begin sampling in 2026 with strategic customers and ecosystem participants across automotive and AI applications.”
